newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish net reserves rise to $22.0 bln in August 1-20. [CORRECTED 11:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Polish net reserves rise to $22.0 bln in August 1-20. [CORRECTED 11:45 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects month in headline and text to August from July.)

Polish net currency reserves, held by the whole banking system, grew $80.6 million in August 1-20 to $22.04 billion and were $1.6 billion higher than at the start of the year, the National Bank of Poland said.
POLISH RESERVES (bln dlrs) AUG 1-20 JULY 96 AUGUST 95
NOTE - Figures in billions of dollars. Official reserves are those held by the state. Net reserves mean the total amount of hard currencies in the whole banking system.
